purpose.zh: 不加重量，练髋部向内转的控制
purpose.en: Train control of turning your hip inward, with no added weight.

text.zh: 大腿和膝盖不动，小腿慢慢向外摆
text.en: Keep your thigh and knee still and swing your lower leg slowly outward

text.zh: 站直，骨盆朝前，一只手轻扶椅子。
text.en: Stand tall, hips facing forward, one hand lightly on the chair.

text.zh: 在舒服的范围内摆，别硬扭膝盖和脚踝。
text.en: Stay in a comfortable range and do not force the knee or ankle.

commonErrors.en: Forcing the knee or ankle to twist.

cautions.zh: 刚开始时每侧先做 1 组 4–6 次，疼就停
cautions.en: When starting out, do one easy set of 4–6 per side, and stop if it hurts.

changes: 改名「扶椅屈膝髋内旋控制」→「扶椅小腿向外摆」（内旋是术语），EN 同步
节奏按 spec 时间轴手算（派生值把 90% 以上都算停顿，和 spec 不符）：摆 1.5/停 2.0/回 2.5/歇 2.0 s
flags: 改名：扶椅屈膝髋内旋控制 / Chair-Supported Isolated Hip Internal Rotation → 扶椅小腿向外摆 / Chair-Supported Outward Shin Swing
tags.activeMuscles 为 glutes+abductors（spec 注明只是髋部大致区域），请定
